气闸即将开启。只能带上两件工具。做好决定后，就进入前哨站。: The airlock is about to open. You can bring only two tools. Make your choice, then enter the outpost.
航程结束。我们抵达了前哨站，还没有昨日的基地记录。: The journey is over. We have reached the outpost. There is no previous mission log yet.
地球确认了我们的研究成果。任务完成，我们可以回家了。: Earth has received our research. The mission is complete. We can go home.
队员安全度过了任务期。还有研究记录未能完成交付，但保护彼此的努力值得被记住。: The crew made it through safely. Some research remains undelivered, but keeping each other safe still matters.
基地已经无法安全继续任务。我们需要停止作业，优先保护队员。: The outpost can no longer support a safe mission. We must stop work and protect the crew.
目前的供电不足以执行这个决定。: There is not enough power for this decision.
今天的安排已经执行。可以关闭终端看看基地，或让这一天结束。: Today's orders are complete. Close the terminal to look around, or end the day.
结束任务，读取最后的记录: End the mission and read the final log
一次性补充供电，储物位置将空出来。: Use the battery once to restore power. Its storage space will be left empty.
让维修变得可靠，仍然需要电力和时间。: Makes repairs reliable. They still take power and time.
代替队员完成部分采样工作，需要较多电力。: Collects some samples for the crew, using extra power.
接入供电系统后就不能再次使用。: Connect it to the power system once. It cannot be reused.
记录环境变化，本身不提供辐射防护。: Records environmental changes. It does not provide radiation shielding.
安装后成为避难区的一部分。: Becomes part of the shelter once installed.
气闸在身后合拢。窗外只有红色荒原，温室里是等待照料的种植槽。我们要在这里度过十四: The airlock closes behind us. Outside lies a red wilderness. Inside the greenhouse, the planting trays need care. We have fourteen Martian days to keep the crew safe and send our research to Earth. Where should we begin?
通信终端亮起了待发送的指示灯。留在基地的研究记录还不算交付，地球需要听到我们的声: The terminal's transmission light comes on. Research stored here has not yet reached Earth. They need to hear from us. But we also need time for food, rest, and tomorrow.
阳光照在面板上，却被薄薄的灰尘挡住。现在清洁，就得放下今天的其他工作；继续等下去: Sunlight reaches the panels, but a thin layer of dust blocks it. Cleaning them means giving up today's other work. Waiting will leave us with less power for the days ahead.
队员打开了食物柜，随后望向温室。植物需要照料，研究也不能一直推迟。今天留给作物，: A crew member opens the food cabinet, then looks toward the greenhouse. The plants need care, but research cannot wait forever. Should we spend today with the crops, or keep to our plan?
风声很远，舱内只剩设备低鸣。例行检查没有发现必须立刻处理的故障。这是难得可以自己: The wind sounds distant. Equipment hums quietly inside. Our routine check found no urgent problems. For once, we can choose how to spend the day.
沙尘吞没了远处的山脊，沙粒不停敲打观察窗。我们必须留在舱内。太阳能板的表面正在积: Dust swallows the distant ridge. Sand keeps tapping against the window. We must stay inside. Dust is settling on the solar panels, so every use of power needs careful thought.
关闭生活舱照明，等待风暴: Turn off the cabin lights and wait
保持照明，安排舱内工作: Keep the lights on and work inside
把今天的工作和一部分电力用于照料作物。: Spend today's work and some power tending the crops.
保留今天的工作机会，继续在终端安排任务。: Keep today's work available and choose a task at the terminal.
让队员休息，今天不再开展其他工作。: Let the crew rest. No other work will be done today.
投入电力和今天的工作，恢复后续供电。: Use power and today's work to restore future generation.
保留今天的工作机会，接受积尘的影响。: Keep today's work available, accepting the effects of dust.
不再安排工作，把电力留在电池里。: Do no more work today and keep the remaining power stored.
今天不再工作，留在舱内避风；生命维持仍然运行。: Stay inside and wait out the storm. Life support keeps running.
留在基地内部，继续安排今天的任务。: Stay inside the outpost and plan today's work.
抵达后的第一天，我们开始安顿这座前哨站。: On our first day, we began settling into the outpost.
我们把第一天留给了温室。种植槽里出现了嫩芽。: We spent our first day in the greenhouse. Shoots appeared in the planting trays.
我们查看了基地，随后安排了当天的工作。: We checked the outpost, then planned the day's work.
我们检查了与地球的通信链路。: We checked our communication link with Earth.
我们检查通信链路后，继续安排基地工作。: After checking the link, we planned the outpost's work.
我们暂缓了工作，让队员在生活舱里休息。: We put work on hold and let the crew rest in the cabin.
我们发现太阳能板上积满了灰尘。: We found dust covering the solar panels.
我们清洁了面板，为接下来的日子保住供电。: We cleaned the panels to protect our power supply for the days ahead.
我们推迟了面板维护，积尘仍然阻挡着阳光。: We delayed panel maintenance. Dust continued to block the sunlight.
我们检查了温室和剩余补给。: We checked the greenhouse and our remaining supplies.
我们照料了温室里的作物。: We tended the crops in the greenhouse.
我们检查了补给，决定继续原来的工作计划。: We checked our supplies and decided to keep to our work plan.
队员完成了一次平静的例行检查。: The crew completed a quiet routine check.
例行检查没有发现新问题，我们继续安排基地工作。: The routine check found no new problems. We continued planning our work.
我们留在舱内待命，把电力留给接下来的日子。: We stayed inside on standby, saving power for the days ahead.
沙暴经过了前哨站，窗外只剩翻涌的沙尘。: A sandstorm swept across the outpost. Churning dust filled the windows.
我们关闭了生活舱照明，留在舱内等待沙暴过去。: We turned off the cabin lights and waited inside for the storm to pass.
我们留在亮着灯的舱内，在风声中继续工作。: We kept the cabin lit and worked to the sound of the wind.
投入电力照料作物，今天不再安排其他工作。: Use power to tend the crops. This takes today's work.
我们照料了作物，种植槽中的叶片舒展开来。: We tended the crops. Leaves unfolded in the planting trays.
在舱内开展实验，研究记录先留存在基地。: Run an indoor experiment. The results stay in local storage until sent.
我们在舱内完成了实验，终端保存了新的研究记录。: We finished an experiment inside. The terminal saved new research records.
把保存的研究记录发送给地球，等待日终确认。: Send stored research to Earth and await confirmation at the end of the day.
我们将研究记录发送出去，等待地球的回应。: We sent our research records and waited for Earth's reply.
投入电力与今天的工作，清除面板积尘。: Use power and today's work to remove dust from the panels.
我们清洁了太阳能板，供电条件得到了改善。: We cleaned the solar panels, improving our power supply.
使用工具箱维护面板，今天不再安排其他工作。: Use the toolkit to service the panels. This takes today's work.
我们用工具箱维护了太阳能板。: We serviced the solar panels with the toolkit.
让队员恢复精神，今天不再安排其他工作。: Give the crew time to recover. This takes today's work.
队员在生活舱里休息了一天，精神有所恢复。: The crew rested in the cabin for a day and recovered some strength.
让机器人采集样本，需要较多电力与今天的工作。: Send the robot to gather samples. It needs extra power and today's work.
机器人完成采样，基地留下了新的研究记录。: The robot collected samples, adding new research records.
投入电力记录环境读数；监测仪本身不提供防护。: Use power to record environmental readings. The monitor provides no shielding.
我们用监测仪记录了环境读数。: We recorded environmental readings with the monitor.
用今天的工作安装加固材料，工具包会从原位消失。: Spend today installing shielding. The kit will leave its storage space.
屏蔽材料已经安装，空出的储物位记录着这次决定。: The shielding is installed. The empty storage space marks our decision.
让设备保持待命，今天不再安排工作。: Leave the equipment on standby. No more work today.
我们没有开展额外工作，把电力留给了明天。: We did no extra work and saved power for tomorrow.
关闭生活舱灯光，留在舱内等待；生命维持仍然运行。: Turn off the cabin lights and wait inside. Life support stays on.
生活舱的灯熄灭了，我们在安静中度过了这一天。: The cabin lights went out. We spent the day in quiet.
恢复生活舱灯光并留在舱内，今天不再安排其他工作。: Restore the cabin lights and stay inside. No other work today.
我们重新打开了生活舱的灯，熟悉的暖光回到房间。: We turned the cabin lights back on. Familiar warmth returned to the room.

通信终端收到了地球的确认，昨天发送的研究记录已经送达。: Earth confirmed receipt of the research we sent yesterday.
食物不足，队员没能吃上一顿完整的晚餐。: Food ran short. The crew could not eat a full evening meal.
夜间的生命维持系统供电不足，队员的状态正在恶化。: Life support lacked power overnight. The crew's condition is worsening.
风沙持续拍打外墙，太阳能板上留下了积尘。: Sand battered the outer walls, leaving dust on the solar panels.
作物已经成熟，我们收获了可以补充食物的这一批。: The crops matured. We harvested this batch to replenish our food.
